messages:
alex: quick heads-up — onboarding 'orchid' (acct 012345678901). Need accelerator quota bump in ap-northeast-3: p5, p4d, g5. We're hitting ENI/vCPU ceilings preventing p5 launches. Can someone take point?

maya: what's the target counts and AZ spread? also do we need ENI increases or subnet changes?

alex: target initial pool: p5=8, g5=16, p4d=2. want headroom -> request ~3x safety cushion. ENI per-subnet is the blocker right now, some launches fail with ENI allocation errors.

sam: last time we did this we opened service-quotas + AWS support case and looped in our TAM. EC2 accelerator quotas need explicit request + ENI/vCPU where applicable. recommend opening case with clear counts, expected spend, and tenancy plan.

jordan: note APNE3 regional stock is spotty for p5. if AWS flags capacity, we may need fallback region routing. suggest specifying preferred AZ spread (3 AZs).

alex: opening support case now and creating internal tracking (FE-5643). will include expected QPS and cost projection.

infra-bot: support-case created: aws-9876543210 — initial response ETA 48h. linked to FE-5643.

maya: when you open the case, include this CLI example and quota codes where possible:
`aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --desired-value 30`
(add quota codes we use in docs)

alex: case aws-9876543210 opened. Requested: p5 -> 24, g5 -> 48, p4d -> 4, ENI regional total -> 1000, account vCPU -> 5000. Attached workload profile and cost calc. pinging @aws-tam for visibility. :white_check_mark:

aws-tam: thanks, I have visibility on 9876543210. I'll prioritize with EC2 capacity/quotas team. Two quick asks: (1) attach a short validation plan (AMI list + smoke tests) so they can validate instance types; (2) confirm your mix (on-demand vs spot) so capacity planning is accurate.

sam: prefer a mix: ~70% on-demand (prod tier), 30% spot (CI). adding that to FE-5643.

jordan: networking note — confirm VPC/subnet sizing. large ENI counts require enough free IPs per subnet and correct ENA drivers. also confirm whether we'll use IPv6.

alex: VPC CIDR 10.40.0.0/16, 3 AZs, subnets /20 each. No IPv6 planned for now. added to FE-5643.

maya: I'll own docs and compliance attachments (SOC2 scope, approved AMIs) in the case. if AWS asks for PO or contract details, escalate to legal/finance.

alex: if AWS denies due to regional capacity, fallback plan is p4d in ap-southeast-2 + traffic policy to route canaries until APNE3 clears. I'll draft the runbook.

sam: action items recap: alex -> support case (done) + runbook; maya -> compliance/docs; sam -> cost breakdown and commit plan; jordan -> confirm AZ/subnet mapping and ENI packing.

infra-bot: FE-5643 updated: owners set [alex, maya, sam, jordan], deadline 2026-03-25. Next update will post here. :spiral_calendar:

alex: thanks all — I'll post case updates here and ping again if AWS requests additional quota codes or tenancy proofs.
